android.//blockedPermissions: expo-audio and expo-image-picker each add RECORD_AUDIO through their config plugins, for recording and for video picking. This app plays one 70 ms beep and imports still images; it opens no microphone. Their own options did not remove it, so it is blocked here, which is the lever that applies last.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: scanner-demo needs the camera to scan barcodes and photograph expiry dates.

plugins.photosPermission: scanner-demo imports packaging photographs from your library into the benchmark dataset.
plugins.//: microphonePermission is off because this app imports still images and never picks video. cameraPermission is deliberately NOT set to false: that adds CAMERA to blockedPermissions, which would strip the permission vision-camera needs.
The app plays a 70 ms beep on a barcode hit and records nothing. The plugin adds RECORD_AUDIO by default; an APK from a public repository must not ask for a microphone it never opens.
